name: Boltbender
oracle_text:
Disguise {1}{R} (You may cast this card face down for {3} as a 2/2 creature with ward {2}. Turn it face up any time for its disguise cost.)
When this creature is turned face up, you may choose new targets for any number of other spells and/or abilities.
blocked_sentences: When this creature is turned face up, you may choose new targets for any number of other spells and/or abilities.

needs.what: an op that retargets objects already on the stack -- here over 'any number of other spells and/or abilities' (every stack object except this trigger), letting this ability's controller optionally choose new legal targets for each chosen one (115.7), leaving the originals on the stack rather than copying them
needs.why_existing_wont_do: The only retargeting in `ops` is the `new_targets` flag on `copy_spell` / `copy_ability`, which retargets a freshly made copy, never the original object; `counter` touches another spell but removes it. No op mutates the target list of an existing stack object. Same capability Deflecting Swat is blocked on, here with a multi-object 'any number of' selection.
